A new bottom bar and smoother scrolling, based on feedback from the first testers.

## What's changed

- **New bottom bar.** The big player card is gone. Now playing sits in its own slim bar above the tabs, with play/pause and next. Tap it to open the full player, where previous and the time are.
- **Tabs have names.** Home, Search and Libraries now show a label under the icon, and the open tab is highlighted.
- **More room for your music.** The bottom bar is smaller and sits lower, so more of every list fits on screen.
- **Smoother Libraries.** Scrolling Songs, Albums and Artists no longer stutters, including when the filter chips hide and come back and when jumping by letter.
- **Smoother artist pages.** The blurred background is now prepared once when the page opens instead of on every frame, so scrolling stays fluid.
